title: Fourier coefficients of a pointwise product
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f,g:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\mathbb R$, and let $S$ be a subset of the coordinates. The Fourier coefficient of the pointwise product $fg$ at $S$ is $\\sum_{T\\subseteq\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}}\\widehat f(T\\triangle S)\\widehat g(T)$, where all coefficients are taken with respect to the uniform measure and the coordinate-product characters.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ and $g$ are real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$S$ is a subset of the coordinates
